game.name: Sonic & Sega All-Stars Racing with Banjo-Kazooie (Brazil)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: Join Sonic and friends in a frantic battle race to the chequered flag. Select from your favourite Sonic and SEGA characters such as Dr. Eggman, Tails, AiAi, Amigo and many more each in their custom built vehicles and personalised All-Star move to get back into the race! Winning is only part of the fun in Sonic & SEGA All-Stars Racing!
